documents.title: Press Release - CPCL Financial Performance For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) achieved its highest-ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT (112% capacity utilization) in FY26 and a Q4 throughput of 2.93 MMT (111% utilization). The reported gross refining margin (GRM) for FY26 stood at $9.28 per barrel and Q4 GRM was $13.75 per barrel, compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel. The company's net debt stood at INR 973 crores with a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09, and total dividends declared for the year reached a record INR 62 per share. Management outlined plans to spend INR 1,600 crores on Group 2 and 3 LOBS and INR 400 crores on retail outlets over the next 2 to 3 years. In the Q4 FY25 earnings conference call, Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported a full-year crude throughput of 10.45 MMT (99.5% capacity utilization) and Q4 throughput of 2.974 MMT (113% capacity utilization).

guidance.claim: CPCL expects to incur around INR 500 crores in normal maintenance capex annually.
guidance.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

guidance.claim: CPCL does not anticipate M&I shutdowns in the first 6 months of FY27, but has a scheduled M&I around September or October.
guidance.quote: First, reply to you , in the first 6 months, we don't see any M&I. So it may not be there. But yes, maybe close to September, October, we have a scheduled M&I of one of our refinery units.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects maintenance CAPEX to be in the Rs. 200-250 crore range for the next year.
guidance.quote: The maintenance CAPEX will be at around Rs. 200-250 crore range and depending on value added projects approvals, the actual will be a little different.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects normal maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX for the next two years to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

guidance.claim: The company expects operational crude throughput in FY 2025-26 to be higher than FY 2024-25 due to lower shutdown impact.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: CPCL increased LPG production to 447 TMT to meet domestic demand amidst global LPG supply uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: CPCL achieved highest ever LPG production of 447 TMT, overcoming previous record of 404 set in 2023-'24. With global uncertainties affecting the availability of LPG all over the world, CPCL is happy to step up the requirement when the nation needed it.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a shortfall of Motor Spirit in the southern market where demand exceeds production by close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth for MS in the southern market is projected at 4%-5% compared to national growth projections of 6%.
demand_outlook.quote: Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%.

demand_outlook.claim: HSD demand growth in the southern market is projected at 3% against national growth forecast of 2.5%.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL incurred a capex of INR 856 crores in FY26 compared to INR 673 crores in FY25.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL's Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project is valued at INR 1,600 crores and retail outlet project at INR 400 crores, spanning 2 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores. So that makes it INR2,000 crores. This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The new LOBS unit will add 250 KTPA capacity in Group 2 and Group 3 grades.
capex_expansion.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL doubled its Hexane capacity from 30 to 60.
capex_expansion.quote: It was 30, now the capacity is 60.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX during FY 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the CBR refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity structure between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has full custody of 1,200 acres of land for the CBR project.
capex_expansion.quote: So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession and the pre-project activities of boundary wall construction, and all those things are almost at a big stage.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL achieved a gross refining margin of $13.75 per barrel in Q4 FY26 compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL's core GRM for Q4 FY26 was $10.3 per barrel.
CPCL incurred a forex loss of approximately INR 200 crores in Q4 FY26 and around INR 350 crores for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL recorded a GRM of $4.22 per barrel for FY 2024-25 compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL achieved a GRM of $6.22 per barrel for Q4 FY25 compared to $7.7 per barrel in Q4 FY24.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY25 included an inventory gain of $0.66 per barrel (Rs. 125 crores), while full-year FY25 saw an inventory loss of $0.06 per barrel (Rs. 40 crores).
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only. But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss was reduced to 8.51% for the full year FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: RLNG consumption increased to 527 TMT in FY 2024-25 from 441 TMT in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: With respect to RLNG and our commitment to net zero, RLNG consumption during the year FY 2024-25, was 527 TMT as against 441 TMT in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL reported GRMs of 11.91, 8.64, and 3.40 $/BBl across the reported periods.
Net operating expenditure was reported at 1085, 1215, and 945 across the reported financial periods.
Singapore GRM was reported at 10.70, 6.58, and 4.02 $/BBl.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL processed a highest-ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, representing 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL processed 2.93 MMT of crude throughput in Q4 FY26, operating at 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved annual production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel and 1.318 MMT for petrol in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL concluded the financial year on a high note, achieving the highest ever production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel HSD, and 1.318 MMT of petrol that is MS, an impressive testament of the refinery's outstanding operational performance.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest-ever distillate yield of 79.1% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Further, highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%, beating our previous record of 77.6% set in 2019-'20 was also achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: Around 90% to 92% of CPCL's products are sold to Indian Oil Corporation Limited at refinery transfer prices.
orders_capacity.quote: No, our agreement, as you would be aware, close to about 90% of our product, mostly HSD, MS, goes to Indian Oil.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT in FY 2024-25, equivalent to 99.5% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year and if you take that into consideration , you will find that this performance is quite comparable to the previous year's performance where CPCL clocked 111% capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput in Q4 FY25 reached 2.974 MMT, representing 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL processed 64% to 65% of high sulfur crude during FY 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: During the financial year, we have processed almost 64% - 65% of high sulfur.

orders_capacity.claim: Manali Refinery has a capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.
Crude throughput was reported at 11316 TMT, 11642 TMT, and 7480 TMT.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL reduced its gross debt-to-equity ratio to 0.18 from 0.39 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL's gross borrowings stand at INR 1,900 crores while net borrowings stand at INR 973 crores with a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL's debt to equity ratio stood at 0.39 as on March 31, 2025, compared to 0.32 as on March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Absolute debt stood at Rs. 3,100 crores and net worth was Rs. 7,939 crores as of March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024. Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL is planning a 2:1 debt to equity ratio for the CBR joint venture.
capital_allocation.quote: Presently, we are working with a 2:1 debt equity for this JV.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth was reported at 6281, 8593, and 7491 in Rupees crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that logistical constraints and crude oil price volatility present operational challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term supply disruptions affected 30% to 40% of Middle East crude long-term commitments over a brief period.
risks_headwinds.quote: What has impacted is that maybe 30% to 40% was affected over a very short period, but all have assured us that depending on the situation, they will make up all the cargoes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Product cracks declined in international markets during FY 2024-25 compared to the previous year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We all know that product cracks have reduced as compared to previous year in the international market, but our endeavor to better the benchmark continues.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude prices presents an ongoing uncertainty for the business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exchange variation loss or gain was reported at 523, 72, and 122.
CST under recovery was reported at 463, 361, and 246.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL expects significant commissioning of retail outlets during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL plans to complete its INR 2,000 crore investment in LOBS and retail outlets over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores. So that makes it INR2,000 crores. This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL has scheduled maintenance and inspection (M&I) for one of its refinery units around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: But yes, maybe close to September, October, we have a scheduled M&I of one of our refinery units.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL targets normal maintenance CAPEX of Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year for the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: Refinery crude unit 1 catering to lubes will undergo scheduled maintenance around August-September 2025.
management_commitments.quote: In 2025, our refinery crude unit 1 which caters to lubes will go into maintenance around August, September.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
